The '''Vulcar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulcar]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vulcar system was established in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
